verdict.rationale: Vercel's Pro plan docs state that billing is per deploying team seat. One seat is included in the platform fee, each additional Owner or Member seat costs $20/month, and Viewer seats are free, so a devops lead can see exactly how cost grows with the team. missing for 10: seat pricing and any seat minimums for Enterprise plans, independent or hands-on corroboration of the seat billing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows

citations.quote: The Pro plan is billed monthly based on the number of deploying team seats, paid add-ons, and any on-demand usage during the billing period.
Seats with Owner or Member roles: $20/month each.
